nodes.title: ➖ Negative Prompt
widgets_values: Avoid blurry, low-quality, noisy, oversmoothed, distorted or messy results. Avoid bad anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers, fused fingers, missing fingers, broken limbs, duplicate body parts, asymmetrical eyes, distorted face, warped features, wrong proportions, cropped head, cut-off body, bad framing, unreadable text, watermark, logo, signature, background clutter, compression artifacts, muddy colors, and inconsistent details. Keep the image clean, sharp, coherent, expressive, and anatomically believable without removing anime styling.

nodes.title: 🎌 Z-Anime Workflow Guide
widgets_values:
## 🚀 Getting Started

Welcome to the official Z-Anime ComfyUI Workflow!
Follow the steps below from top to bottom and you'll have your first image in no time.

---

## 📦 Step 1 — Load Your Model

There are three loaders available depending on which version you downloaded.
Use the **📦 Step 1 - Load Models Switch** node to select the right one by toggling **Yes / No**.
Only one loader should be active at a time.

**📦 Load GGUF Models**
For all GGUF variants (Q4, Q8, etc.)

**📦 Load Checkpoint Models**
For all AIO (All-in-One) versions — VAE and Text Encoder already included.

**📦 Load Diffusion Models**
For all Diffusion format versions — loads UNet, CLIP and VAE separately.

> Make sure the correct model file is selected inside the active loader node before generating.

---

## ✍️ Step 2 — Write Your Prompt

Write your prompt in the **✨ Positive Prompt** node.

**Tip:** Look up a Z-Image prompting guide and feed it to an AI like ChatGPT — then ask it to write prompts for you. Z-Anime works best with natural, detailed descriptions rather than short tag lists.

For **Z-Anime Base** the negative prompt is fully supported and strongly recommended.
For the **Distill variants** (8-Step / 4-Step) the negative prompt has limited effect — you can leave it empty.

---

## 📐 Step 3 — Choose Your Resolution

Set your output resolution in the **📐 Image Size** node.

Check the **📐 Resolution Guide** node for recommended presets:

- **832 × 1216** — Portrait / Character art ⭐
- **1216 × 832** — Landscape / Scenes
- **1024 × 1024** — Square
- **768 × 1344** — Full body / Tall
- **1920 × 1088** — Cinematic / Widescreen
- **1024 × 1536** — High quality portrait

---

## 🎨 Step 4 — Generate Your Image

This step contains two nodes:

**🎲 Seed Control**
Set your seed here. Switch to **fixed** if you want to reproduce the exact same image with the same prompt and settings. Switch to **randomize** to get a new result every run.

**🎨 Generate Image**
Adjust the settings depending on which model version you are using:

*Z-Anime Base:*
```
Steps:  28–50
CFG:    3.0–5.0
```

*Z-Anime Distill-8-Step:*
```
Steps:  8
CFG:    1.0  (max ~1.5)
```

*Z-Anime Distill-4-Step:*
```
Steps:  4
CFG:    1.0  (max ~1.5)
```

---

## 🔼 Step 5 — Upscale (Optional)

Toggle the upscaler on or off with the **🔼 Toggle Upscaler ON/OFF** node.

**📏 Scale Image**
Sets the upscale multiplier. Default is **1.5×**.

Example:
A 1024 × 1024 image at 1.5× becomes **1536 × 1536**.

**🔄 Upscale Sampler**
Uses the same settings as **🎨 Generate Image** with one extra option — **Denoise**.

The Denoise value controls how much the upscaler changes your image:
- **0.0** — no change, just larger
- **0.35** — default, adds fine detail while keeping the original look ⭐
- **1.0** — completely new image

**🔍 Compare Images**
Use this node to compare your original image side by side with the upscaled result.

---

*Happy generating!* 🎌

nodes.title: 📖 Z-Anime Info
widgets_values:
# 🎌 Z-Anime

**Full Fine-Tune on Z-Image (Base)** — Anime-optimized model with rich aesthetics, strong diversity and full negative prompt support.

---

## ⚡ Quick Start

1. Load model (BF16, FP8, GGUF or AIO)
2. Write your prompt
3. Set resolution
4. Generate!

---

## ⚙️ Settings by Variant

### 🎌 Z-Anime Base
```yaml
steps: 28–50
cfg: 3.0–5.0  (up to 9.0 possible)
sampler: euler_ancestral ⭐
scheduler: beta ⭐
negative: strongly recommended
```

### ⚡ Z-Anime-Distill-8-Step
```yaml
steps: 8
cfg: 1.0  (max ~1.5)
sampler: euler_ancestral
scheduler: beta
negative: limited effect
```

### 🚀 Z-Anime-Distill-4-Step
```yaml
steps: 4
cfg: 1.0  (max ~1.5)
sampler: euler_ancestral
scheduler: beta
negative: limited effect
```

---

## 📦 Versions

| Version | Prec. | Size | Use Case |
|---------|-------|------|----------|
| 🎌 Z-Anime Base | BF16 | ~12GB | Max quality |
| 🎌 Z-Anime Base | FP8 | ~6GB | Daily use |
| ⚡ Z-Anime-Distill-8-Step | BF16 | ~12GB | Fast + quality |
| ⚡ Z-Anime-Distill-8-Step | FP8 | ~6GB | Fast, low VRAM |
| 🚀 Z-Anime-Distill-4-Step | BF16 | ~12GB | Ultra fast |
| 🚀 Z-Anime-Distill-4-Step | FP8 | ~6GB | Ultra fast, low VRAM |
| 📦 GGUF Q8_0 | — | ~6.7GB | Low VRAM / CPU |
| 📦 GGUF Q4_K_S | — | ~4.2GB | Very low VRAM |
| 📦 AIO Base + 4-Step + 8-Step | BF16/FP8 | varies | Single-file (VAE+TE built-in) |

All versions run on **8GB VRAM**!

---

## 🎯 Features

✅ Rich anime style & aesthetics
✅ Strong diversity (identities, poses, layouts)
✅ Full negative prompt support (Base)
✅ Natural language prompts
✅ Fine-tunable — LoRA training ready
✅ High resolution (up to 2048×2048)
✅ Partially NSFW capable

---

## ⚠️ Desktop ComfyUI Issue

If metadata save fails, replace **"💾 Save Z-Anime"** nodes with standard **"Save Image"** node.

---

## 📥 Links

widgets_values: Anime movie film still, cinematic anime, high-budget animation. Wide cinematic shot of a beautiful young woman with long straight black hair and large dark eyes standing at a rural Japanese railroad crossing as a train rushes past in a horizontal blur of silver and blue, her hair and the hem of her navy school skirt pulled by the train's wind. Hundreds of cherry blossom petals swirl in the turbulence around her. Bright spring afternoon sunlight floods the scene from the upper left, backlighting the blossoms so each petal glows translucent pink. She stands perfectly still amid the chaos, hugging a school bag to her chest, eyes closed, peaceful. Soft pink, bright spring green, silver train blur, warm sunlight gold. Atmospheric petal haze, sharp figure against motion-blurred train.
